	method = farming

	color = goods_horses

				OR = {
					topography = plateau
					OR = { topography = flatland topography = ha1300_topo_rolling topography = ha1300_topo_valleys topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = ha1300_topo_deltas }

				}
				OR = {
					climate = cold_arid

					climate = mediterranean
					OR = { climate = oceanic climate = ha1300_climate_highland_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_subpolar_oceanic }
